appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' and has tick marks at intervals of 500, from 0 to 3,500.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 1880 to 1891.
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 1880 to 1891.
The line starts at 1,100 tourists in 1880, rises to a peak of about 2,450 in 1886, dips to about 2,250 in 1888, and then rises sharply to about 3,200 in 1891.
The line is not monotonically decreasing; it has multiple upward and downward movements.
The final data point in 1891 is the highest on the chart, at approximately 3,200 tourists.
The initial data point in 1880 is the lowest on the chart, at 1,100 tourists.
